dee.screen.title: Edit Text Display
dee.tooltip.styled_text:
This text has formatting (color, translate key, etc.). Editing this field removes the formatting.
To keep it, turn on [Adv.] and edit it there.
dee.tooltip.advanced:
When on, edit the text NBT directly as SNBT.
Example: {translate:"my.key"}
dee.tooltip.delete: Deletes this display entity. (Click twice to confirm)
dee.advanced.title: Advanced NBT
dee.advanced.hint: SNBT format · empty removes the value · red = syntax error · scroll with wheel
dee.chat.not_found: Could not find the display entity you are looking at
dee.chat.creative_only: This can only be used in Creative mode
dee.tooltip.place: Closes the UI. Press the editor key where you want it to set the position there.
dee.chat.place_hint: Press %s at your current position to move the display to you (ESC: cancel)
dee.tooltip.block:
Block ID. Example: oak_stairs or minecraft:oak_stairs
Red = unknown block
dee.tooltip.block_properties:
Block properties, comma-separated as key=value.
Example: facing=east,half=top
Red = syntax error or property the block does not have
dee.tooltip.item:
Item ID. Example: diamond_sword or minecraft:diamond_sword
Red = unknown item
dee.tooltip.item_profile:
Skin of the player head (shown only for player_head).
- Player name: Notch
- Texture value (Base64) from Minecraft-Heads
- Texture URL or 64-character hash
Empty = default skin
Red = invalid format
dee.item_context.head: Head
dee.tooltip.auto_align: Align the position of the block display to the block grid (integer coordinates).
dee.tooltip.pick_block: Choose from a list of all blocks. (Search by name or ID)
dee.tooltip.pick_item: Choose from a list of all items. (Search by name or ID)
dee.tooltip.editor_mode: Creates the entity now and lets you move, rotate and scale it in the world with gizmo handles. (ESC to exit)
dee.gizmo.title: Editor mode - %s
dee.gizmo.help: %1$s Move  %2$s Rotate  %3$s Scale | %4$s drag: edit | %5$s while dragging: cancel | ESC: exit
dee.gizmo.help2: %1$s: select | %2$s + %1$s: multi-select | %3$s / %4$s: edit UI & parts | %4$s with nothing in view: new display
dee.gizmo.help3: Ctrl+Z undo | Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y redo | Ctrl+X / C / V cut / copy / paste | Ctrl+D duplicate | Ctrl+A select all | Ctrl+G group | Del delete
dee.tooltip.group: Binds the selected displays into one group. A group is selected, moved, rotated and scaled as one.
dee.tooltip.ungroup: Dissolves this group. The displays stay where they are.
dee.panel.title: Parts (%s)
dee.chat.gizmo_lost: Could not find the entity being edited; editor mode ended
